notes: Toxins (E. coli's own RNase toxins) expressed from pBAD30 with arabinose for 10 min after washing into glucose-free M9 + casamino acids + glycerol: native_overexpression; MazF samples also carry pKVS45-MazE (antitoxin). Empty-vector samples (induced) are controls at each arabinose level. growth_phase inferred from OD 0.35 before the wash (>=40 min before harvest). Libraries were gel-extracted after PCR (finished-library size selection): total_rnaseq.

growth_phase.q: Overnight cultures were back diluted into fresh media and grown 3-4 hours to an OD600 of ~0.35 at 37°C in an orbital shaker at 200 RPM.

culture_mode.q: Overnight cultures were back diluted into fresh media and grown 3-4 hours to an OD600 of ~0.35 at 37°C in an orbital shaker at 200 RPM.

base_medium.q: Overnight cultures (12-16 hrs) were grown at 37°C in M9 media supplemented with 0.1% casamino acids, 0.4% glycerol, 0.4% glucose, 2 mM MgSO4, and 0.1 mM CaCl2.

medium_class.q: Overnight cultures (12-16 hrs) were grown at 37°C in M9 media supplemented with 0.1% casamino acids, 0.4% glycerol, 0.4% glucose, 2 mM MgSO4, and 0.1 mM CaCl2.

carbon_source.q: Cultures were centrifuged, washed, and back diluted into media lacking glucose.

inducer_added.q: Para was induced by adding arabinose to quantity described.
